description: Mystic enchants, custom equipment caches, seasonal event gear, and the Bloodforged and Heroic versions of stock items
reason: Custom gear carries statistics and belongs in the same budget as everything else. The range has no upper bound: this realm numbers its Heroic versions above the old limit of 600000, and anything placed there later is equipment too.
